about_the_game:
An RPG with naughty beautiful girls!!!

◆System

An orthodox dungeon strategy RPG

Explore each dungeon, defeat the boss, and move on to the next dungeon.

1. Play easily with cheat equipment.

2. You can't defeat the last boss and EX/some enemies with cheat equipment.

3. Full of replay value: Collector's items

4. Plenty of hidden items (small medal system)

5. Stages with the same dungeon and battle music

◆Treasure Chest

There are treasure chests that will respawn by going back and forth between dungeons.

There is a low chance that rare items will be inside those treasure chests.

◆System

The concept of this game is an "answer game."

In other words, you can't win unless you put in a specific character.

You can't defeat the boss unless you have protection skills that correspond to the boss and exploit its weaknesses. (Except for exceptions)

Change characters every time and put in characters that have skills that are suitable for the boss.
